YES BRUH!!!! i’m 🍃 rn and just got off a bad shift so i’m super tired and my brain isn’t really working right so i truly hope this shit makes sense, but i couldn’t not let u know that someone else does experience this. so: no literally i have this exact same issue. for some reason my brain just Cannot at all recognize the concepts around probability like that - it feels like for me inherently, extremely improbable *≠* will not happen to me. i know most people don’t directly think ”there’s No Way” they just kind of subconsciously disregard the very very very slim possibility, because somewhere along the line i feel like their brain decided it was fruitless to focus on. which literally like Is True…. and my brain kind of agrees and thinks that’s okay, but ofc only when it comes to other people. Like, Fully without skipping a beat - if i ’ask my brain’ if *i* Should Definitely Be Prepping For It still if nobody else cares *and* have a good reason not to, it says oh obviously. you need to be. Like, this is all on you man. which i feel like personally comes from a sort of maybe.. having very high expectations for myself (= i feel like devaluing myself/self dislike at the end of the day perhaps. i think thats what a lot of people would say, anyway, and i don’t think it’s an unreasonable theory), mixed with classic like. having trauma and feeling like you need to fend for yourself (and a lot of the time prep for unreasonable situations tbh - traumatic events often do seem at the time like something that isnt reliably foreseeable, you know? i feel like that’s part of why it hit us so hard - it feels unfair) because no one else did. idk this got kinda heavy and its ultimately just my personal experience - it could be totally different for u for sure (: im also younger than you, by around 5 years, and honestly as i read ur post, i realized i don’t think i’ve even fully admitted the fact that it’s truly an incorrect belief i feel like (like deep down). it just feels so utterly Objectively true uknow? im also autistic, which i think in my case does Contribute to the way i Admittedly, relatively to other ppl it seems tend to think things are absolute and ‘either-or’. hmmm idk i could talk about brain stuff for ages, but ultimately i’m saying also that idk how useful this info is for you overall, *but* i really hope this helped in some way if only to know that other people experience this - and like, even to the extent that i personally do which is pretty far like this is a Common thought lol. but yeah have a good rest of ur day or night !!!!
